runtimes.name: csagent_dev_support
runtimes.description: Customer Support Agent (Strands) - order lookup, customer lookup, refunds

strategies.name: customer_preferences
strategies.description: Stated preferences: contact channel, language, regions, delivery choices.

strategies.name: customer_facts
strategies.description: Durable facts the customer states about themselves or their account.

agentCoreGateways.name: csagent-dev-tools
agentCoreGateways.description: Business tools for the customer support agent, exposed as MCP tools

toolDefinitions.name: get_order
toolDefinitions.description: Look up a single order. Use this for any question about an order, including where it is, why it is late, and what was paid. The order's delivery state is in `order_status` (for example DELAYED or DELIVERED) and the reason in `status_reason`; the top-level `status` field reports only whether the lookup itself succeeded. `total_cents` is an integer number of US cents (24999 means $249.99).

order_id.description: Order identifier in the form ORD-<digits>, e.g. ORD-1001. If the customer says a bare number, prefix it with ORD-.

toolDefinitions.name: get_customer
toolDefinitions.description: Look up a customer account: name, email, loyalty tier, preferred contact channel, and the IDs of the orders they have placed. Use this for questions about the person rather than about a specific order.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier in the form CUST-<digits>, e.g. CUST-001.

toolDefinitions.name: process_refund
toolDefinitions.description: Refund money against an order. This moves money. The amount is validated against the order total and against the automatic-approval ceiling before anything is written; refunds above the ceiling are declined here, not by the assistant. Calling it twice with the same idempotency_key returns the first refund instead of issuing a second.

order_id.description: Order to refund, in the form ORD-<digits>.

amount_cents.description: Amount to refund as an integer number of US cents. $249.99 is 24999. Must be greater than zero and not more than the order total.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key identifying this refund attempt. Derived by the caller from the operation (or session), the order and the amount; reused verbatim on any retry. A repeat of the same key returns the original refund and never creates a second one.

operation_id.description: Optional. The caller's retry token for the wider operation, e.g. operation-123. Recorded with the refund so a retry can be traced back to the request it belongs to; it does not affect the idempotency decision, which is made on idempotency_key alone.

policyEngines.name: csagent_dev_policy
policyEngines.description: Deterministic authorization for customer support tool calls

policies.name: permit_get_order
policies.description: Allow reading an order. Required: the engine denies by default.

policies.name: permit_get_customer
policies.description: Allow reading a customer record. Required: the engine denies by default.

policies.name: refund_limit
policies.description: Allow a refund only up to the $1,000 ceiling (100000 cents).

policies.name: forbid_refund_over_limit
policies.description: Forbid refunds above $1,000 outright; a forbid cannot be overridden by any permit.
